aisha: FYI overnight CI flagged a p95 spike for smallbatch: 468ms (bench-id 2026-09-03-07). 2/3 runs failed. link: https://bench.redwood/rd/2026-09-03-07 — can someone pick this up?
nightly-bot: [alert] perf-ci: smallbatch p95 > 450ms for run 2026-09-03-07 (notified eng-runtime)
liam: on it. can you paste the minimal repro params? I'll try a quick local run to see if it's reproducible.
mike: quick checklist: check kvcache evictions, batcher occupancy, and kernel samples. first command to grab traces: `rbctl traces get --run 2026-09-03-07 --out traces.tgz`
jen: I pulled the partial trace — there's a short spike around step 24. attention_forward op latency jumps. queue lengths on node-3 look elevated in that window.
mike: snippet from kernel samples: ```json
{"step":24,"op":"attention_forward","lat_ms":38,"host":"i-0a1b2c","thread":"worker-7"}
```
liam: thanks. which model variant was serving that run? could be a quant/float fallback mismatch.
aisha: it's pinned to `gpt-medium-v2-quant` on canary (rollout 2/5). no svc commits in last 48h, but a quantize cron ran yesterday morning.
ops-bot: deploy: canary scaled 2 -> 4 at 02:12 UTC (autoscale).
liam: ok — I'll try to recreate with same seq/batch. command I'll run: `./scripts/run_bench.sh --seq 1024 --batch 4 --run-id debug-543` — will post logs here.
jen: one more note: kernel scheduler spinwait counts ticked up same timeframe. could be host contention rather than model code.
mike: if it's spinwait/host-contend, infra should confirm noisy neighbor on node-3. @infra can you check i-0a1b2c around 02:10-02:15 UTC?
infra: looking now — host metrics show snapshot job spike CPU on i-0a1b2c at 02:11:40 UTC, concurrent with the bench. CPU steal ~12%, IO busy briefly.
aisha: OK plan: liam will attempt repro locally with same flags; mike will collect full traces + kernel samples for the failing window; infra will mute snapshot jobs on that host for next night and hunt for noisy neighbors. reconvene in thread after repro or if additional evidence comes up. :thumbsup:
liam: noted — starting repro now, expect logs in ~45m and will paste `debug-543` link when done.
